title: Stonecutter Plus
description: New crafts on stonecutter and more!
body:
This data pack adds the ability for stone cutters to process wood and more!!

Datapack features:
- Wood processing on the Stonecutter (balanced against the crafting table)
- Use of Packed Mud in Stonecutter
- Invisible Item Frame crafting
- Invisible Light crafting
- Smelting of ore blocks
- Removal of the copper duplication exploit via the stonecutter
- Horse and Nautilus Armor (all variations)
- Blackstone
- Gilden Blackstone

All Crafts you can seen in [gallery](https://modrinth.com/datapack/stonecutter_plus/gallery).
